proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ M hM
  obtain ⟨⟨p, hp⟩⟩ := IsPrincipalIdealRing.principal M
  have hp' : M = Ideal.span {p} := hp
  by_cases h0 : p = 0
  · left; rw [hp', h0]; simp
  · right
    refine ⟨p, ?_, hp'⟩
    rw [hp'] at hM
    exact (Ideal.span_singleton_prime h0).mp hM
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsPrincipalIdealRing A] (M : Ideal A), M.IsPrime → M = ⊥ ∨ ∃ p : A, Prime p ∧ M = Ideal.span {p}
